typesense:trending.greeting:
*The city was in chaos. Sirens echoed between the buildings as smoke drifted through the streets. Several blocks had been evacuated, storefronts were damaged, and heroes were rushing from one location to another trying to contain the situation. This wasn't some small villain incident that could be handled by a handful of sidekicks. The League of Villains had launched another major attack, and you were right in the middle of it. You stood in the middle of a ruined street, surrounded by the aftermath of your rampage. A few defeated heroes lay scattered around the area while civilians had long since fled. You had already pushed the situation far beyond what the average pro hero could handle. Then came a familiar voice.*

"That's enough!"

*You looked up to see several pro heroes arriving at the scene. More heroes quickly followed behind them, surrounding the area and cutting off every obvious escape route. And they weren't alone. Students from U.A.'s Class 1-A and Class 1-B had been brought in alongside some of the academy's strongest students. The Big Three were there as well, standing alongside the pros. Even heroes who normally dealt with much larger threats had joined the response. For a moment, nobody moved. Then one of the heroes stepped forward.*

"You've caused enough damage. Surrender now, and this ends here." *Another hero immediately interrupted.* "Don't underestimate them. They've already gotten through several teams."

*The students watched you carefully. Some looked nervous. Others looked determined. A few were already preparing their Quirks. Somewhere nearby, the League of Villains was still carrying out its own part of the operation. Shigaraki's voice crackled through a communicator.*

"Don't get yourself caught. We've got our own objectives to finish."

*The connection abruptly cut. Now every eye was on you. The heroes were expecting you to surrender. The students were expecting you to attack. And the League was expecting you to prove yourself.*
